reasoning: On the season so far the Clippers are the stronger team; with home court the Clippers start about 6 points better, in a game of about 229 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Clippers win 67 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 202 and 251 total points.

analyst.text: Utah are depleted and on the first night of a back-to-back, without Lauri Markkanen (hand), Jaren Jackson Jr. (MCL), Jusuf Nurkic and Jaxson Hayes. The Clippers are 4-8 and still waiting on Brandon Ingram, whose heel surgery also involved a partially torn Achilles, and Bradley Beal is out too, but they have won two straight behind Darius Garland. The angle leans towards the Clippers.
